title: Eufy’s Versatile Security Camera Is the Cheapest It Has Ever Been
gist: Wired deal piece recommending the Eufy Wall Light Cam S4 at $170 (down from $250), praising its subscription-free local storage and on-device AI while noting 15 fps and battery top-ups. Also flags discounts on the Indoor Cam S350 ($100) and EufyCam C35 2-Cam Kit ($130).

themes.theme: Eufy Wall Light Cam S4 deal

insights.claim: The Eufy Wall Light Cam S4 is discounted from $250 to $170 (32 percent off), and the author considers it overpriced at the original price.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Signals Eufy's list pricing runs ahead of what reviewers will endorse; wait-for-discount buyers get value.
insights.locator: I also feel it’s overpriced at the original $250

insights.claim: The S4 combines a swiveling 4K camera, 32 GB built-in local storage, solar panel and motion-activated wall light with no subscription required, including on-device AI that distinguishes people, vehicles and pets.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Subscription-free local recording is a competitive contrast with cloud-subscription camera rivals.
insights.locator: It records locally, with 32 GB of storage built in

insights.claim: The S4's downsides are a 15 fps frame rate that blurs fast subjects in the dark and the need to top off the battery occasionally, especially as winter reduces solar charging.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Hardware trade-offs at the price point.
insights.locator: Some downsides: the frame rate is just 15 fps

insights.claim: The Eufy Indoor Cam S350 is $100 ($40 off) and the author predicts it will drop another $20 by Black Friday.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Indicates a possible further price trough for shoppers who wait.
insights.locator: you might want to wait for Black Friday

insights.claim: The EufyCam C35 2-Cam Kit is $130 ($70 off) and includes a HomeBase Mini for local recording plus onboard AI with facial recognition.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Local-hub AI features are Eufy's bundle strategy.

insights.claim: The author says security cameras are useful beyond security, for checking children's arrival, pets and nighttime noises.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Broader household use cases support demand for the category.
